reason: A Neutralino.js-based desktop GUI shell that attaches to a running dsh web session and manages its separate local server process across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

summaries.zh: 为正在运行的 dsh web 会话提供跨平台原生桌面窗口外壳，并集成桌面打开入口。
summaries.en: Provides a cross-platform native desktop window shell for a running dsh web session with an integrated desktop-open entry point.

capabilities: Provides a native desktop window for an existing web session
Starts and manages a separate local server process
Adds a desktop-open control to the client interface
